page.overview:
Who is Bro Bros.?

The Bro Bros. are minor characters who serve as a boss enemy in Mario & Luigi: Brothership.

The Bro Bros. are a Hammer Bro, a Fire Bro, and an Ice Bro.

The Bro Bros. are encountered during the first visit to Skorcheen Island when Mario and Luigi are about to reach the island's lighthouse. The Bro Bros. explain that they were looking for Bowser (who is on Wayaway Island). Mario and Luigi explain that they have a mission to reconnect Concordia's islands. The Bro Bros. seemingly understand and prepare to leave so Mario and Luigi can continue their mission; however, the Bro Bros. reveal that they are just faking it and ambush the Bros., triggering the fight. Following the battle, the Bro Bros. disappear from the map, likely implying their deaths.

In combat the Bro Bros. reuse the same tactics as the rest of their species.
